paragraphs: As in Pesachim 117b, where he asked Rava. In Chullin 80a he said to Rav Ashi: “Ameimar permits their fat.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Pesachim 117b and Chullin 80a paragraphs support Rav Chanan addressing Rava and then Rav Ashi, with the supplied Ameimar quotation. The source heading’s student description remains Hyman’s biographical characterization; these two conversations do not independently admit a teacher or chronology edge. No other disputants or legal details are imported.
